-- Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2b-T12: `Lean.reduceBool`, under which
-- the kernel evaluates its argument with compiled code. In a theorem the axiom
-- pass sees `Lean.trustCompiler`, which the opaque's body names; inside an
-- `example` nothing records it. The kernel evaluates a constant only, so the
-- input is a definition, which reaches no axiom. The deprecation linter is
-- switched off for the one command.
def plantedNativeInput : Bool := true

set_option linter.deprecated false in
example : plantedNativeInput = true := (rfl : Lean.reduceBool plantedNativeInput = true)
